content: 1. The metabolism of futibatinib is influenced by hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Co-administration with drugs that are dual P-gp and strong CYP3A inducers may reduce the efficacy of futibatinib. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 2. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of ganaxolone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inducers. If unavoidable, consider increasing the ganaxolone dose, but do not exceed the maximum daily dose based on weight. 3. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of gepirone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 4. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of gilteritinib, which is a substrate of P-gp and CYP3A4. Co-administration with combined P-gp and strong CYP3A inducers decreases gilteritinib exposure and efficacy. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 5. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of glasdegib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A inducers. Use an alternative drug. 6. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of glecaprevir/pibrentasvir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. 7. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of hydrocortisone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 8. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of hydroxyprogesterone caproate by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 9. Rifampin decreases the levels of ibrutinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Strong CYP3A inducers reduce ibrutinib plasma concentrations by approximately 10-fold. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 10. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of idelalisib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers, as they significantly decrease systemic exposure to idelalisib. 11. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of iloperidone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 12. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of indinavir by increasing its metabolism through CYP3A4. Co-administration is contraindicated. 13. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of infigratinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 14. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of irinotecan by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 15. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of irinotecan liposomal by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 16. Rifampin increases the toxicity of isoniazid by enhancing its metabolism to hepatotoxic metabolites. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 17. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of istradefylline by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 18. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of ivabradine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with moderate CYP3A4 inducers. 19. Rifampin reduces the levels of ivacaftor by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers, as systemic exposure to ivacaftor is substantially reduced (~9-fold). 20. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of ivosidenib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers, as they reduce ivosidenib plasma concentrations. 21. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of ixabepilone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 22. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of ixazomib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A inducers, as they decrease ixazomib Cmax by 54% and AUC by 74%. 23. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of lansoprazole by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 24. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of lapatinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 25. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of larotrectinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. If co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers is unavoidable, double the larotrectinib dose. Resume the prior dose after discontinuing the inducer for 3-5 half-lives. 26. Rifampin increases the levels of lasmiditan by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 27. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of lefamulin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A inducers unless the benefit outweighs the risks. Monitor for reduced efficacy. 28. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of lemborexant by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 29. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of leniolisib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 30. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of letermovir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Co-administration with P-gp inducers is not recommended. 31. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of lomitapide by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 32. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of lopinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 33. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of loratadine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 34. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of lovastatin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 35. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of lumateperone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 36. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of lurbinectedin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 37. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of macimorelin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration may lead to false-positive test results. Discontinue strong CYP3A4 inducers and allow sufficient washout time before testing. 38. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of macitentan by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 39. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of maraviroc by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 40. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of mavorixafor by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 41. Rifampin decreases the levels of mestranol by increasing its metabolism. This may result in contraceptive failure. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 42. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of methadone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 43. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of methylprednisolone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 44. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of midazolam by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 45. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of midostaurin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Strong CYP3A4 inducers may reduce midostaurin concentrations, leading to decreased efficacy. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 46. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of naldemedine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. 47. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of neratinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers. 48. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of netupitant/palonosetron by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid use in patients chronically using strong CYP3A4 inducers. 49. Rifampin decreases the levels or effects of nevirapine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. 50. Rifampin reduces the levels or effects of nicardipine by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug.
